name: Vacation Rentals & Short-Term Rentals
summary: Pre-arrival instructions, cleaning turnovers, pricing alerts, and guest reviews.

automations.title: Pre-Arrival Check-In Instructions
automations.summary: A set number of days and hours before a guest's arrival, this automation automatically sends check-in instructions, door codes, and local…
steps: A set number of days and hours before a guest's arrival, this automation automatically sends check-in instructions, door codes, and local recommendations, timed so the information arrives fresh instead of getting buried in an inbox from weeks earlier.
Guests show up already knowing exactly how to get in instead of texting the host from the driveway.
automations.manualProcess: The manual version of this puts the entire workload on a property manager, who has to juggle phone calls, emails, and spreadsheets just to keep things moving. It's the kind of work that quietly eats hours every week.

automations.title: Cleaning Turnover Scheduling
automations.summary: The moment a guest checks out, this automation automatically notifies the cleaning team with the turnover deadline before the next guest arrives…
steps: The moment a guest checks out, this automation automatically notifies the cleaning team with the turnover deadline before the next guest arrives, and flags the property manager if a same-day turnover is at risk based on the cleaner's confirmed availability.
A cleaner double-booked or unavailable gets caught with hours to spare instead of discovered at check-in time.
automations.manualProcess: Left to a person, this means an operations coordinator re-enters the same data more than once, double-checks it by hand, and still occasionally misses something. It's the kind of work that quietly eats hours every week.

automations.title: Dynamic Pricing Adjustment Alert
automations.summary: This automation monitors local occupancy trends, nearby events, and competitor pricing, and automatically flags nights where the current listed…
steps: This automation monitors local occupancy trends, nearby events, and competitor pricing, and automatically flags nights where the current listed price is significantly under or over market.
The host adjusts before losing bookings to a price that's too high, or leaving money on the table with a price that's too low, instead of setting a rate once and forgetting about it.
automations.manualProcess: Left unautomated, a revenue manager spends hours on the parts of this job that don't require judgment: copying data, sending reminders, and tracking status by hand. Over a month, those small manual steps add up to a significant amount of lost time.

automations.title: Guest Review Request & Response Automation
automations.summary: After checkout, this automation automatically requests a review from the guest, and separately drafts a suggested response to any review the host…
steps: After checkout, this automation automatically requests a review from the guest, and separately drafts a suggested response to any review the host receives, positive or negative, for the host to approve and post.
Response time stays fast and consistent instead of depending on the host remembering to check the listing.
automations.manualProcess: Without this system, a guest experience manager manually pieces together information from different places, then has to relay it to everyone who needs it.

automations.title: Guest-Reported Maintenance Ticketing
automations.summary: When a guest reports an issue during their stay, a broken appliance, a maintenance need, this automation automatically creates a maintenance ticket…
steps: When a guest reports an issue during their stay, a broken appliance, a maintenance need, this automation automatically creates a maintenance ticket and routes it to the appropriate vendor or handyman, tracking it to resolution.
The issue stops getting lost three messages deep in a guest chat thread that no one revisits after checkout.
automations.manualProcess: Without automation, a property manager has to notice problems after they've already happened, then scramble to fix them manually one at a time. It rarely feels urgent in the moment, but it adds up fast.
